壱 — 01
The art

Not a fight.
A way of moving.

Aikido is the Japanese martial art of blending with an attack and redirecting it — no brute force, no aggression. It suits every body and every age.

Aikido teaches you to move with balance, timing and calm — to meet force with flow instead of meeting it head-on. That is why it works for everyone: teenagers finding their confidence, adults getting fit, and anyone who wants to know they can look after themselves.

At Taupo Aikido Club you train at the Taupo-nui-a-tia College gym, in a club where beginners are welcomed properly and nobody is left to figure it out alone.

01

Blend, don’t clash

Learn to move off the line of attack and use an attacker’s own energy.

02

Balance first

Good posture, good movement, good timing — the rest follows.

03

Train with respect

Partners look after each other. You practise, you learn, you go again.
